summary.text: Kim Wallan is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 6 who has served since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kim Wallan served on the Medford School District school board, Position 5, from 2011 to 2015.
She succeeded Sal Esquivel in the Oregon House of Representatives and took office in 2019.

In the 2023-2024 session, Wallan was assigned to the House Energy and Environment, Gambling Regulation, Judiciary (as vice chair) and House Rules committees, and served as co-vice chair of the Joint Committee on Semiconductors.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, and faces Democrat John Holm in the general election.
